input.quote: AbbVie shall pay to Harpoon a royalty on Net Sales of each Licensed Product in the Territory (excluding Net Sales of each Licensed Product in any country or other jurisdiction in the Territory for which the Royalty Term for such Licensed Product in such country or other jurisdiction has expired)
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase, volume, take-or-pay or shortfall commitment on AbbVie (our party). Searches for "minimum", "purchase", "commit", "supply", "volume", "forecast" and "shortfall" return only (i) the Article 11.6 insurance minimum limits, which are coverage floors and not purchase commitments, and (ii) supply provisions under which AbbVie holds the sole right (not an obligation) to Manufacture or have Manufactured and supply Licensed Compounds and Licensed Products (Section 4.5.1) — there is no obligation to source any quantity from Harpoon. AbbVie's financial obligations are milestone payments and royalties calculated on actual Net Sales, which are licence consideration tied to actual commercialization rather than a volume commitment, and Section 6.5.2 expressly ends the royalty obligation when the Royalty Term expires. This satisfies the preferred position (no minimum commitment; payment tied only to actual usage/sales), so no redline is warranted and the fallback true-up/reduction mechanics are unnecessary.
